description: How the seven-card horseshoe tarot spread works: its positions from past to likely outcome, a worked example and tips for reading the arch.
lede: The horseshoe tarot spread arranges seven cards in an arch. It looks at the past, the present, hidden influences, you, others, advice and a likely direction.

layout.alt: Seven numbered tarot cards arranged in an arch like a horseshoe, from lower left to lower right: 1 Past, 2 Present, 3 Hidden influences, 4 You, 5 Others, 6 Advice, 7 Outcome.
layout.caption: The arch rises to the hidden, personal and relational cards at the top, then comes down to advice and a likely outcome.
